name: David Burton site + Loupe
install: python3 -m pip install --quiet pillow && (cd loupe && npm install) && python3 build.py

terminals.name: Loupe editor
terminals.command: node loupe/serve.js --content data --output dist --build "python3 build.py --no-fetch" --uploads assets/photos=/photos --no-push --port 4343
terminals.description: In-place editor: builds, matches and annotates the site, served with the Loupe overlay at http://localhost:4343/ (rebuilds on Save).

terminals.name: Static preview
terminals.description: Plain preview of the built static site (dist/) at http://localhost:8000/.
